_comment: Configuration for tools/arifi-sync. Everything a stranger must be able to change lives here.
No path below is required to exist for `provenance`, `series`, or `recipe` to work.
`ref` is MANDATORY and MUST be the source's real default branch. Do not guess main/master:
PrismML's default branch is `prism`; resolving `prisml/master` instead silently reports a
DIFFERENT branch's head as drift. That mistake was made once during this tool's own authoring.
`pin` is the commit of that source we have actually reviewed. `currency` compares live head
against `pin`; it CANNOT be satisfied by doing nothing, because acknowledging drift requires
writing the newly-reviewed sha here.

2026-08-16: ALL SEVEN forks are registered here now. ciru and tq3 were remotes of this repo that this file had never listed, so their work was invisible to `currency` - 198 and 394 fork-authored commits nobody had reviewed. A source that is not in this file is a source that silently drifts; add every remote you fetch.
2026-08-17 lane-139: `base.ref` is NEW and is MANDATORY reading. `base.upstream_sha` and the
branch the series describes are ONE PAIR and must move together. Before this, the sha lived here
and the branch was hardcoded `master` in three argparse defaults, so moving the base alone
produced an INVALID pair: `master` (the pre-rebase branch) is not a descendant of the new base
at all, and `4df29be4f..master` is not a range anybody meant to ask for. Set both, or neither.

_ref_comment: The branch the series describes. `series regen|check` and `provenance` default `--ref` to this.
KNOWN RED, lane-139 2026-08-17: this pair does NOT produce a replayable series yet, and the
tool now says so out loud instead of implying it in the `status` header. `4df29be4f..recut/
2026-08-16` is 312 commits containing ONE merge, `70a752991` (the union merge). `format-patch`
omits merge commits by construction, so the three conflict resolutions that merge made by hand
(fork README, the Vulkan mul_mm store_a refactor, repack.cpp make_block_q1_0x4) are not in any
patch, and the commits that BUILD ON those resolutions cannot apply. Measured, not predicted:
replaying all 300 generated patches onto 4df29be4f dies at 0081, `merge-fix-post-merge-build-
and-crash-issues`, with an unparseable conflict in src/llama-context.cpp. Evidence:
The fix is to LINEARIZE the union branch (rebase the TurboQuant series onto 4df29be4f instead
of merging it), which re-shapes a branch a checker has already blessed. That is a President/HQ
call, not a lane's - lane-139 surfaced it and stopped.

rocmfpx.pin_review_2026_08_17_lane139: Reviewed b2f5829db..f4b2c5a3e, 18 non-merge commits. NOTHING in this range advances the ROCmFP GPU matmul: it is 11 speculative/MTP/server commits (spec-boundary cache salvage by checkpoint rollback, the MTP boundary ring, an M-RoPE draft-position fix landed as 61b71b5a2, reverted by 06b38c681, then re-landed as 7d43016f4), 3 NVFP4 commits (lm_head scale side-tensors claimed and saved, then narrowed to NVFP4-only in 5466f3bb0, and NVFP4 exposed as a llama-quantize target), and 4 build/test fixes. REFUTATION of the brief's framing: the handoff says to port 'Charlie's CURRENT mul_mm path', implying his head moved it - it did not. His mul_mm work predates our b2f5829db pin, so re-fetching his head does not change what GOAL 2 must port. SECOND REFUTATION: the President's pointer that Charlie 'posts near-daily claiming all-AMD RDNA1-4.5 support' is NOT corroborated by this tree. docs/ROCmFP4-ARCH-FIT-RESULTS.md, read IN FULL, is a THIRD-PARTY contribution measuring ONE device (Ryzen AI Max+ 395, gfx1151, RDNA 3.5) on ROCm 7.2.4, and makes no RDNA1-4.5 claim anywhere. Its finding is about model shape, not GPU generation: active parameter count tracks the decode win (~8B active +62.6%, ~11B active +18%, ~6.5B active with MLA flat, ~3B active with hybrid-linear attention -37% at 37K context and discarded). Its author flags an earlier hypothesis of his own - that high expert count predicts an FP4 win - as WRONG; expert count predicted nothing. Two methodology notes worth adopting for lane 141's benches: force equal generation length between arms, and defeat the prefix cache with a leading nonce while asserting cached_tokens==0. Note also that STRIX_LEAN, the format it measures, is an FTYPE (a quantize recipe, 106), not a distinct GGML_TYPE - it is our GGML_TYPE_Q4_0_ROCMFP4 under a size-biased K/V recipe, so it needs no new type id. The items still owed from the older range below are unchanged and unaddressed.

_comment: The recipe is recovered by DIFFING a CMakeCache against the committed snapshot, never by
grepping it. Grepping a cache for flags you already remember missed -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00,
LLAMA_USE_PREBUILT_UI=OFF and -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++, and cost three failed builds.
F-085, President-ruled and BINDING: the regression judge is llama-server.
NOT llama-cli. NOT llama-bench. `binary` is not configurable to another judge on purpose.
Bench purity: reuse a binary within a comparison, never reuse a historical number,
never run timed arms under sibling load.
judge.note_no_host: --no-host is REQUIRED whenever a CPU_REPACK path is under test. Without it make_cpu_buft_list() puts the device host buffer type ahead of the CPU extra buffer types and the repack path never engages, so both A/B arms silently test the same code.
